name: Pronominal references

seen.excerpt: MESURÉ le 08/08/2026 sur les 272 articles XML JATS de l'atelier : 212/272 (78 %) ouvrent au moins une phrase par une reprise nue (It/They/These/This), 3 260 occurrences au total ; 49/272 (18 %) portent une reprise lexicale explicite — relevé « In the latter study, the risk of developing T2DM was significantly lower » (bio-PMC12915353).
seen.excerpt_en: MEASURED on 2026-08-08 on the 272 JATS XML articles of the workshop: 212/272 (78 %) open at least one sentence with a bare anaphor (It/They/These/This), 3,260 occurrences in total; 49/272 (18 %) carry an explicit lexical anaphor — recorded: "In the latter study, the risk of developing T2DM was significantly lower" (bio-PMC12915353).
